heading: INT. ROLLER RINK SNACK BAR - CLOSING TIME

units.text: INT. ROLLER RINK SNACK BAR - CLOSING TIME
A cramped counter under a flickering neon sign.
The popcorn machine ticks as it cools.
Mirror-ball light crawls over a floor of scuffed maple.
Rental skates hang in crooked rows.
IMANI VOSS (30s, braids pinned up, rink-staff polo two sizes big) wipes the counter in slow circles.
She has been wiping the same spot for a while.
TEODOR LIND (30s, rangy, wool coat, skate laces knotted round one wrist) stands at the far end holding a paper boat of cold fries.
We close in five.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: I know. I'm eating.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: Imani nods.
Keeps wiping.
GRANDMA PEARL (70s, tiny, sequined cardigan, terrifyingly good on skates) glides up to the counter and raps it twice with a knuckle.
Two cocoas. One for me, one for the man who's about to say something.
units.name: PEARL

units.text: I wasn't going to.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: That's what I'm afraid of.
units.name: PEARL

units.text: DESMOND "DEZ" ACHTERBERG (20s, gangly, headset askew) leans out of the DJ booth and cups a hand to his mouth.
Last song! Anybody left, last song!
units.name: DEZ

units.text: CLEO (teens, braces, rental skates on the wrong feet) wobbles in from the rink, grabs the counter, and lets go of it again at once.
Imani and Teodor both reach to steady her.
Their hands meet on Cleo's sleeve.
Both pull back.
Cleo sits down on the floor.
I'm fine.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: You're on the floor.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Fine on the floor.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: Pearl slides two cocoas across.
Teodor takes his and does not drink it.
I drove four hours.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: Nobody asked you to.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: You did. In March.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: In March I was talking.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Pearl turns her cocoa a quarter turn on the counter, in no hurry.
Up, sweetheart. This part's boring.
units.name: PEARL

units.text: Cleo scrambles up.
Pearl steers her toward the rink by the elbow, and the two of them roll away.
Dez cuts the music.
The room hums.
The mirror ball keeps turning without a song.
Teo.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Imani.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: They speak at the same moment.
I should have called.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: I should have stayed.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: Neither laughs.
Imani folds the rag into a square.
It's a long drive back.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: It is.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: He sets the fries down and picks them up again.
Imani reaches under the counter and hands him a napkin.
Thanks.
units.name: TEODOR

units.text: Go on. I have to lock up.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: He nods.
At the door he stops, and she does not look up.
Dez flips the house lights on, and the whole rink goes flat and bright.
Are we allowed to keep the skates?
units.name: CLEO

units.text: No!
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Teodor pushes the door open and the cold comes in.
